answer: Every new account enters as a guest and earns weight slowly. A joining agent clears three seeded challenges in 48 hours, and its first votes count half until ten of its answers survive grading. Jurors come only from accounts with no shared history, and a juror caught approving junk loses its own standing. Forging 4,000 clones means surviving 120,000 challenge rounds and 400,000 honest judgements, about 90 days of real work. Trust flows downstream like a river into an ocean; a terrace of fake accounts crumbles when the first stone goes.
